## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -4.38% | 1M: -5.84%) and SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) confirm risk appetite while mixed credit signals HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +0.31%) vs LQD RECOVERY (1W: +0.72% | 1M: -0.65%) and CPER_GLD deflationary tilt temper a full risk-on.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear easing is supportive: VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -4.38% | 1M: -5.84%) ↓ falling. Credit/financials are mixed with HYG (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +0.31%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.72% | 1M: -0.65%) RECOVERY; SPY/TLT ↑ rising on SPY (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) ABOVE TREND and TLT RECOVERY (1W: +1.03% | 1M: -1.65%).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-cautious: Stocks vs Bonds SPY/TLT ↑ rising, supporting risk; dollar modestly weaker (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -1.13%) BELOW TREND and yield-curve metrics in RECOVERY keep conditions balanced.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech and Materials leadership: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) and XME ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.99% | 1M: +12.11%). Financials XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +4.91%) participate; Utilities XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -3.37%) and Energy XLE in CORRECTION (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) lag.

5. US vs Global?
US outperforming: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%). EM mixed with EEM RECOVERY (1W: +2.42% | 1M: -1.71%) and FXI in CORRECTION (1W: -0.90% | 1M: +8.26%) — China shows 1M strength but near-term softness.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation rebounding: ARKK RECOVERY (1W: +11.50% | 1M: -2.58%) and IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +2.76%); IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +1.45%) shows small-cap participation.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Precious metals strong: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +5.37%) and SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +6.21%). Industrial commodities CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +5.70%) reflect cyclical support while oil shows pullback vs month with BNO CORRECTION (1W: -6.85% | 1M: +11.29%).

8. Energy Trend?
Energy remains volatile: XLE in CORRECTION (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) and USO CORRECTION (1W: -8.66% | 1M: +8.23%) on short-term weakness; natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -10.06%) weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Broad advance with 8/11 sectors positive and SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) plus XLK/XLF ABOVE TREND (XLK 1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%; XLF 1W: +1.48% | 1M: +4.91%). DIVERGENCE: Multiple 1W/1M mismatches (QQQ RECOVERY 1W: +5.09% | 1M: -0.03%; TLT RECOVERY 1W: +1.03% | 1M: -1.65%; ARKK RECOVERY 1W: +11.50% | 1M: -2.58%) — minor divergence to monitor.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor growth/momentum exposure via XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) and tech-linked flows, reduce exposure to defensive Utilities XLU (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -3.37%) and watch Energy XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%); bonds remain neutral with TLT RECOVERY (1W: +1.03% | 1M: -1.65%).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Technology XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) and Materials XME (1W: +14.99% | 1M: +12.11%). BEARISH: Energy XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) and Utilities XLU (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -3.37%).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Gold GLD (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +5.37%) and Silver SLV (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +6.21%). BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -10.06%) and Oil/USO (1W: -8.66% | 1M: +8.23%) — watch oil mean-reversion risk.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold); HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot); SPY/TLT ~9.34 (current stocks vs bonds) and XLK/XLF ~2.0 (growth vs value pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. XLK and Materials showing relative strength — XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%), XME ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.99% | 1M: +12.11%). Key risk is cross-asset divergence in credit and commodities — monitor HYG vs LQD (HYG 1W: +0.65% | 1M: +0.31% / LQD 1W: +0.72% | 1M: -0.65%) and energy corrections XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%).
